messages:
alex: Noticing a persistent host CPU uplift (~20%) on short streaming requests after the selector+batching merge. Incoming traces point at repeated selector scoring + repeated kv lookups.
sophie: timeframe + region? can you paste the pprof top?
alex: spike started 2026-03-26T14:00 UTC. affected regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1. quick pprof top (sanitized):
```
# top 8
16.8% kernel_selector::score_candidates
13.5% kv_cache::lookup
10.4% http2::hpack_decode
8.9% parse::assemble_frame
7.6% tokenize::scan_ascii_fastpath
6.0% batch_coordinator::shrink_window
5.4% writev::flush
3.1% sched::wakeup
```
ben: score_candidates that high suggests it's running per-chunk. batching change rescores when window shrinks, which can trigger O(chunks) scoring for fragmented streaming.
sophie: kv eviction rate jumped ~12% and variant_id churn observed. keys include a new ephemeral stamp field. that would explain kv churn.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-26T13:58 by @ci (selector-batching:v20260326) -> canary 10% -> promoted 13:59
ben: repro plan: run wrk lua script to simulate multiplexed short streams (30-80 tokens) and collect CPU profile. sample command: `wrk -t6 -c180 -d45s --latency 'lua_short_stream.lua' http://ingress:8080/v1/stream` then `go tool pprof -http=:8081 /tmp/ingress.cpu`.
sophie: immediate mitigations: 1) roll selector rescore-on-shrink back on canary 2) add fastpath: if token_count<128 reuse memoized decision keyed by (route, model, quant_profile, small=true) 3) stabilize variant_id generation to remove ephemeral stamps 4) add metrics: selector_calls_per_request, kv_evictions_per_minute, hpack_decodes_per_request.
alex: I'll start a canary rollback now and run the wrk repro before/after.
ops: note: increasing batching window by 1-2ms reduces chunk churn but may slightly increase median latency; we'll tune once we validate.
perf-bot: perf CI shows +6.7% CPU regression on 50-token perf-test after rollout.
ben: follow-ups: - implement selector memo LRU with short TTL - ensure selector scoring is at most once per logical request when feasible - audit kv key derivation to exclude ephemeral salts - add unit perf-tests for 0-128 token path and for fragmented http2 frames.
sophie: after rollback runs, please paste flamegraphs and pprof links here. if CPU returns to baseline, we push the memo/stability patches and canary again.
alex: rollback in progress. will update with traces. :thumbsup:
